content.text: Inbox file is untracked; use plain mv.

I moved `inbox/2025-12.csv` to `data/2025-12.csv` and committed it as `577a62c` with the message "2025-12: add rows".

`scripts/check.sh` passed before the commit. The message starts with `2025-12`, which matters because the nightly import reloads only the month each commit message starts with.

I used a plain `mv` rather than `git mv`, because the inbox file was never tracked in git. That means the inbox copy is gone. If you wanted it kept there, say so and I'll put a copy back.
